question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Crooked
solution:
The correct answer is "Twisted."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Crooked" means not straight or even, bent. (मुड़ा-तुड़ा, टेढ़ा-मेढ़ा)

 
 
• Example: *That picture is **crooked**__.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of "Announced" is "Declared."
 
• The word "Twisted" means bent so that the original shape is changed or destroyed. (इस प्रकार मोड़ा जाता है कि मूल आकार बदल जाए या नष्ट हो जाए)
 __
 
• Example: *It was a **twisted**__ tree trunk.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Admirable: **that you admire; excellent. (प्रशंसनीय; श्रेष्‍ठ)
 
• **Taken: **something that has been acquired or seized
 
• **Toasted: **cook or brown (food, especially bread or cheese) by exposure to a grill, fire, or other source of radiant heat. (ग्रिल, आग, या तेज गर्मी के अन्य स्रोत के संपर्क में आकर (भोजन, विशेष रूप से ब्रेड या पनीर) पकाना या भूरा करना)
